title: Microsoft Azure
summary: For AZ-900 first: the concepts, services and tools of Azure. Six guided projects are done in your own Azure account, which you clean up afterwards so they cost nothing or close to it.

failover.title: Account failover
failover.body: GRS and GZRS keep a copy in a secondary region, so the data is durable if the primary is lost. Writing to it again needs an account failover, and reading from it without one needs RA-GRS or RA-GZRS.

rehydration.title: Rehydration
rehydration.body: A blob in the archive tier can't be read or changed. It has to be rehydrated to the hot, cool or cold tier first, which can take up to 15 hours.
